markScheme.a: 'vaulting ambition' 1.7: ambition; the Divine Right of Kings makes regicide a sin. 'unsex me here' 1.5: gender and power; Jacobean expectations of women. Dagger 2.1: the supernatural and guilt; James I's interest in witchcraft. Neptune 2.2: guilt and blood. 'Out, damned spot!' 5.1: guilt and madness; conscience and damnation. 'all my pretty ones' 4.3: grief and tyranny; Macduff as the true loyal subject.
